environment: JSDOM 26.1.0 with user-event 14.6.1; not a real browser

checks.name: Initial workspace renders all eight labelled sample invoices
Reset confirmation starts an empty invoice workspace
Invoice file import creates the 30-row ledger
Receipt file import produces exact totals and ignores five duplicate rows
Reimporting through the UI adds no payment credit
Search narrows the ledger to the requested invoice
A review decision cannot be saved without a choice and note
Saving a noted assignment credits SYN-029 and leaves SYN-030 unpaid
CSV export invokes a downloadable report with invoice and receipt records
Workspace save retains all imported data and the review decision
Restoring through the UI preserves balances and manual decisions
Invalid transaction IDs show an error without a network call
A simulated provider failure shows its error and offers no output import
Failed lookups preserve the previous ledger and evidence

instrumentation: ResizeObserver and viewport-dependent APIs are stubs
Downloads are intercepted as real Blob contents
Fetch is stubbed only for the provider-error UI
Node File supplies the uploaded fixture bytes
remaining: Actual browser interactions and file downloads
